verdict.rationale: Open WebUI is a self-hosted platform that 'runs anywhere' (Docker, Kubernetes, pip, bare metal), is built to run entirely offline, and supports air-gapped deployment. The operator therefore chooses where the instance, and by implication its data, lives. The evidence never explicitly documents data-residency or storage-location controls, and connected cloud model providers may send data elsewhere. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of where data is stored and how storage or database location is configured, residency guarantees when cloud providers are used, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: Open WebUI runs anywhere (Docker, Kubernetes, pip, bare metal)
self-hosted AI platform that's extensible, feature-rich, user-friendly, and built to run entirely offline
Air-Gapped: Complete network isolation for environments with the strictest security requirements.
